changeLog.change: Approved document and desktop screenshot audited before source edits. Preserve all84 scenarios and26 gates; existing driver design remains authoritative. Baseline checks in progress; no fabricated UI data.

Core Dispatch Centre, scoped read projection, additive070 contact, shared availability/payment/expiry/release guards and declined-assignment exceptions implemented. Driver source adds heartbeat only. Individual manual assignment retained; safe bulk write absent, map provider and native builds deferred; all84 scenarios and26 gates remain. Initial test labels READ/CONTACT/PAY were corrected before acceptance mapping to avoid confusing them with prescribed scenario IDs. Old implicit-availability fixtures now explicitly declare availability; schema-marker fixtures advance70→71 without weakening runtime permissions.

Final458/458 tests pass with zero skipped using a fresh isolated PostgreSQL16 container and matching pg_dump/pg_restore tools. Initial17→16 restore-tool mismatch logs retained (secrets redacted), then matching-tool restore/role/worker tests pass. Native binaries and hosted rollout remain deferred; no new production approval.

Mapped existing executed canonical regression assertions into exact applicable scenarios instead of labelling already-tested backend behaviour untested. Scenario PASS means bounded test evidence, not independent operational release. Device/physical/staging gaps and all26 gates remain separate.

Final safety audit reproduced missing serial allocation being rejected only at final issue. Extracted that existing canonical guard and reused it at dispatch readiness;53 affected tests pass. No custody/financial history rewritten. Exact assignment reason, negative odometer and duplicate fuel receipt assertions pass12-test follow-up. All84 scenarios and26 gates retained; physical/native/production sign-offs remain open.

Final full460/460 zero-skipped regression passed after shared serial fix. Follow-up18/18 passes private customer-latest/expired-URL/retained-history checks plus261-record counts. Above250 readiness candidates, no incomplete count is published and unnecessary probes are skipped. Manual view-status detail UI exposes actual capture/receipt/accuracy or explicit unknowns. No provider activation, native build, hosted migration or real fulfilment.

Final read-projection regression reproduced accepted orders being counted ready before canonical preparation. Reused orderTransitions for state eligibility, blocked premature candidate selection and added per-order Review preparation/View details through the existing tracking component scoped by canonical orderId. Defaults preserve legacy driver/history use.18 dispatch/photo follow-ups and final web build/types pass; no operational data or release flags changed.
